scope: Typed common ACAD_REACTORS group-330 and ACAD_XDICTIONARY group-360 output for DXF entities.

behavior: Typed reactor source IDs must be nonzero; an XDICTIONARY source ID of zero remains the absent-edge value.
Typed common references are resolved before group publication. Direct-remap output ID zero refuses the entity record atomically.
A configured resolver result of zero omits that optional reference and its wrapper, preserving established resolver semantics.
Retained common app-data groups are validated by writeAppData under the related p4-common-appdata-reference-output-id-guard receipt.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary LINE controls: zero reactor source and zero direct-remap outputs refuse without published bytes; valid direct mappings emit exact group-330/group-360 IDs; resolver-zero optional references omit their groups and preserve following-record framing.

limitations: This proves local ID representation, remapping, omission, and record rollback only. It does not prove target existence, target kind, ownership, recursive closure, physical producer support, or native semantics.
next: Continue the source-backed reference and ownership audit; do not infer target validity from a nonzero mapped ID.
